entity.title: CLI configuration
entity.description: Behaviour of strspc init and the .strspc/config.yaml it writes.

rules.body: MUST write a `.strspc/config.yaml` that declares at least one rule source.
MUST NOT print URLs that do not resolve.

notes.content: Core rule SPCFG-004 requires every config to declare at least one rule source; a commented-out template fails lint on first use.
Help text, next-step hints and generated config comments in src/cmd/*.go.
